concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

concepts.label: Entity Public Float
concepts.description: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concepts.label: Accrued Employee Benefits, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

concepts.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Asset, Weighted Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The calculated weighted-average amortization period of a major class of finite-lived intangible assets acquired during the current period either individually or as part of a group of assets (in either an asset acquisition or business combination). A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar, either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

concepts.label: Acquired Indefinite-lived Intangible Asset, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate cost of a major indefinite-lived intangible asset class acquired, during the period, either individually or as part of a group of assets (in either an asset acquisition or business combination).

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital
concepts.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.

concepts.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
concepts.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

concepts.label: Advertising Expense
concepts.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

concepts.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
concepts.description: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
concepts.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

concepts.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
concepts.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

concepts.label: Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.description: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value portion of probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Recurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents the aggregate of the assets reported on the balance sheet at period end measured at fair value on a recurring basis by the entity. This element is intended to be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period
concepts.description: Amount of net credit losses charged off.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Bridge Loan
concepts.description: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

concepts.label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Amortizable Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to an identifiable intangible asset that will be amortized.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to assets acquired.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed), Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The total purchase price of the acquired entity. This includes cash paid to equity interest holders of the acquired entity, fair value of debt and equity securities issued to equity holders of the acquired entity, and transaction costs paid to third parties to consummate the acquisition.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to current assets.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to current liabilities of the acquired entity.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to the current portion of long-term debt of the acquired entity.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Goodwill Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of goodwill arising from a business combination, which is the excess of the cost of the acquired entity over the amounts assigned to assets acquired and liabilities assumed.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to liabilities assumed.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to other noncurrent assets not separately disclosed.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to other noncurrent liabilities not separately disclosed.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of acquisition cost of a business combination allocated to property, plant and equipment to be used in ongoing operations.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The pro forma net Income or Loss for the period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
concepts.description: Costs incurred to effect a business combination which have been expensed during the period. Such costs could include business integration costs, systems integration and conversion costs, and severance and other employee-related costs.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Liabilities
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities assumed at the acquisition date.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as current.

concepts.label: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations
concepts.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
concepts.description: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Net
concepts.description: The total gross amount less the charge for the use of the long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Executory Costs
concepts.description: Amounts to be paid by lessee to lessor for maintenance, insurance, and tax expenses related to the leased asset.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Interest Included in Payments
concepts.description: Amount necessary to reduce net minimum lease payments to present value for capital leases.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The total contractually required rental payments on capitalized leases net of deductions for: (i) executory costs, including any profit thereon, included in the minimum lease payments and (ii) the amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce the net minimum lease payments to present value.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Present Value of Net Minimum Payments
concepts.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, including amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Amortization Expense
concepts.description: The charge for the use of long-lived depreciable capital leased assets for the period.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Indemnification Agreements, Payments
concepts.description: Amount of payments made under the terms of an indemnification agreement contained in a lease.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
concepts.description: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Current
concepts.description: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Noncurrent
concepts.description: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Deferred Income
concepts.description: The remaining (unamortized) difference between the gross investment in a direct financing lease and the cost or carrying amount, if different, of the leased property as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Minimum Payments to be Received
concepts.description: Amount of remaining payments as of the balance sheet date that lessees are obligated to make or can be required to make under direct financing leases, including any guarantee of residual value and executory costs. The amount also includes any guaranteed rental payments by an unrelated third-party provided that are financially capable of making such payments.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Unguaranteed Residual Values of Leased Property
concepts.description: The estimate of the lease property's economic value at the end of the direct financing lease term excluding any amounts guaranteed by either the lessee or a third-party.

concepts.label: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concepts.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
concepts.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from Collections Reinvested in Revolving Period Transfers
concepts.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to collections reinvested in revolving period transfers related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

concepts.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from New Transfers
concepts.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to newly transferred assets related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Discontinued Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities of discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities of discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of operating activities of discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Commercial Paper
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
concepts.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

concepts.label: Common Stock Dividends, Shares
concepts.description: Number of shares of common stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the "benchmark" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division.

concepts.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage
concepts.description: "For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the ""benchmark"" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division."

concepts.label: Construction in Progress, Gross
concepts.description: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

concepts.label: Continuing Involvement with Transferred Financial Assets, Principal Amount Outstanding
concepts.description: Principal amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction. Continuing involvement includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
concepts.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Reclassified to Receivable
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time from transfer to receivable due to right to consideration becoming unconditional.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
concepts.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Cost Method Investments
concepts.description: Amount, after adjustment, of cost-method investment. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, dividends received in excess of earnings after date of investment that are considered a return of investment and other than temporary impairments.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
concepts.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods Sold (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Total costs related to goods produced and sold during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Cost of Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Total costs related to services rendered by an entity during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Costs and Expenses
concepts.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

concepts.label: Cumulative Effect of New Accounting Principle in Period of Adoption (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) to equity or (increase) decrease to net assets, resulting from the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Customer Advances and Deposits
concepts.description: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

concepts.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

concepts.label: Debt, Current
concepts.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Increase of additional borrowings on existing and new debt instruments.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
concepts.description: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

concepts.label: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
concepts.description: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

concepts.label: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
concepts.description: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Equity
concepts.description: Value of stock issued under share-based plans to employees or officers which is the unearned portion, accounted for under the fair value method.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred federal income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Subject to Expiration
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are subject to expiration dates.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the allowance for doubtful accounts.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences, with jurisdictional netting and classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of employer security in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, security issued or managed by related party of employer.

concepts.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Amounts that Will be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate amount in accumulated other comprehensive income expected to be recognized as a component of net periodic benefit cost over the fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position presented, including the net gain (loss), net prior service cost or credit, and net transition asset or obligation.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount to be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost for the fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position, including gain (loss), prior service cost (credit), and transition asset (obligation).

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
concepts.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
concepts.description: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
concepts.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Rate of Compensation Increase
concepts.description: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The effect of a one-percentage-point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for health care benefits.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The effect of a one-percentage- point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the aggregate of the service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement health care benefit costs.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
concepts.description: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed for Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: The assumed health care cost trend rate for the next year used to measure the expected cost of benefits covered by the plan (gross eligible charges). This is based upon the annual rate of change in the cost of health care benefits currently provided by the postretirement benefit plan, due to factors other than changes in the composition of the plan population by age and dependency status.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed, Next Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Assumed rate, for next fiscal year, based on annual change in cost of health care cost benefits used to measure expected cost of benefits covered by defined benefit postretirement plan. Factors include, but are not limited to, estimate of health care inflation, change in health care utilization or delivery pattern, technological advances, and change in health status of participant. Excludes factors for change in composition of plan population by age and dependency status.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
concepts.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
concepts.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation, Decrease for Subsidy
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for government subsidy related to prescription drug benefits attributed to past service.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Curtailment
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of defined benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Recognized Net (Gain) Loss Due to Settlements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of net gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit cost as a result of an irrevocable action that relieves the employer (or the plan) of primary responsibility for a benefit obligation and eliminates significant risks related to the obligation and the assets used to effect the settlement. Examples of transactions that constitute a settlement include (a) making lump-sum cash payments to plan participants in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and (b) purchasing nonparticipating annuity contracts to cover vested benefits.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Target allocation percentage of investments in debt securities to total plan assets presented on a weighted-average basis as of the measurement date of the latest statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Target allocation percentage of investments in equity securities to total plan assets presented on a weighted-average basis as of the measurement date of the latest statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Target allocation percentage in other than debt securities, equity securities, and real estate to total plan assets presented on a weighted-average basis as of the measurement date of the latest statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Target allocation percentage of investments in real estate to total plan assets presented on a weighted-average basis as of the measurement date of the latest statement of financial position.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: The ultimate trend rate for health care costs.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate
concepts.description: Ultimate trend rate for health care cost for defined benefit postretirement plan.

concepts.label: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
concepts.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

concepts.label: Derecognized Assets, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period
concepts.description: Net credit losses are charge-offs and are based on total loans outstanding during the period.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value of Collateral
concepts.description: Fair value of securities received as collateral against derivative assets.

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value of Collateral
concepts.description: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against derivative liabilities.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Distribution Made to Member or Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Declared (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The equity impact of cash distributions declared to a common shareholder or unit-holder by a LLC or LP.

concepts.label: Distribution Made to Member or Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of cash distributions paid to a common shareholder or unit-holder by a LLC or LP.

concepts.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
concepts.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

concepts.label: Dividends Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividend, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to restructuring charges.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
concepts.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

concepts.label: Employee Benefit and Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
concepts.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate proceeds received by the entity during the annual period from exercises of stock or unit options and conversion of similar instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

concepts.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
concepts.description: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

concepts.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Allocated Shares
concepts.description: The shares or units in an ESOP trust that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula. IRS rules require allocations to be nondiscriminatory generally based on compensation, length of service, or a combination of both. For any particular participant such shares or units may be vested, unvested, or partially vested.

concepts.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
concepts.description: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of assets reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of current assets reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of current liabilities reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Equity Excluding Noncontrolling Interests (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of equity, excluding noncontrolling interest, attributable to the equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations reported by an equity method investee.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Extraordinary Items and Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: This item represents the disclosure of summarized financial information for unconsolidated subsidiaries and 50 percent-or-less owned entities accounted for using the equity method of accounting. If investments in common stock of corporate joint ventures or other investments accounted for under the equity method are, in the aggregate, material in relation to the financial position or results of operations of an investor, it may be necessary to present summarized information as to assets of the investee, or group of investments for which combined disclosure is appropriate, either by individual financial statement caption or in groups, as appropriate. Such summarized financial information may, at a minimum, include income or loss from continuing operations before extraordinary items and cumulative effect of a change in accounting principle.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities and Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of liabilities and equity reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Sales or Gross Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: This item represents the disclosure of summarized financial information for unconsolidated subsidiaries and 50 percent-or-less owned entities accounted for using the equity method of accounting. If investments in common stock of corporate joint ventures or other investments accounted for under the equity method are, in the aggregate, material in relation to the financial position or results of operations of an investor, it may be necessary to present summarized information as to assets of the investee, or group of investments for which combined disclosure is appropriate, either by individual financial statement caption or in groups, as appropriate. Such summarized financial information may, at a minimum, include net sales or gross revenues.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of noncurrent assets reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of noncurrent liabilities reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Revenue (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of revenue from sale of product and rendering of service reported by equity method investee.

concepts.label: Equity Method Investments
concepts.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

concepts.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI
concepts.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Annual Amount
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Cumulative Amount
concepts.description: Amount of cumulative impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
concepts.description: Amount of gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Cumulative Amount
concepts.description: Amount of cumulative gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of gain (loss) classified as extraordinary item, including amount attributable to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
concepts.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net
concepts.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
concepts.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
concepts.description: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
