concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
concepts.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Sale
concepts.description: Amount of decrease from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale of financing receivable.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate amount of intangible asset amortization recognized as expense during the period.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Fixtures and Equipment, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of fixtures and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, machinery, equipment, and engines.

concepts.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
concepts.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Furniture and Fixtures, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year five of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year four of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year one of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year three of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year two of the five succeeding fiscal years.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
concepts.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
concepts.description: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
concepts.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of loss recognized that results from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Other Changes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of other (increase) decrease of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of an asset representing the future economic benefits from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Transfers
concepts.description: Amount of transfers into (out of) an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
concepts.description: Amount of divestiture of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
concepts.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

concepts.label: Guaranty Liabilities
concepts.description: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
concepts.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
concepts.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
concepts.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) from extraordinary items, net of related tax effect, per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period attributable to extraordinary items that is available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
concepts.description: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
concepts.description: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all assets and liabilities used in operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
concepts.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
concepts.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
concepts.description: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Incurred
concepts.description: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

concepts.label: Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

concepts.label: Interest Income, Other
concepts.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

concepts.label: Interest Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
concepts.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Investment Income, Dividend
concepts.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

concepts.label: Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value portion of investment securities, including, but not limited to, marketable securities, derivative financial instruments, and investments accounted for under the equity method.

concepts.label: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
concepts.description: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

concepts.label: Land
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
concepts.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
concepts.description: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

concepts.label: Leveraged Lease Investment
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of leveraged lease investments which represent the aggregate amount of the estimated residual value of the lease assets and lease payments receivables, net of unearned and deferred income to be allocated over the lease term and non-recourse debt.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Deferred Taxes Arising from Leveraged Leases
concepts.description: The liability for taxes payable in the future as a result of temporary differences in treatment of certain items in the current year arising from the net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income from Leveraged Leases
concepts.description: Pretax lease income allocated in proportionate amounts from unearned income.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income Tax Expense on Leveraged Leases
concepts.description: The tax effect from the current year income from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Income
concepts.description: The estimated portion of pretax income and investment tax credit remaining to be allocated to income over the lease term.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Gross
concepts.description: The gross rentals receivable equal to the future cash flows from the lessee.

concepts.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Residual Value of Leased Assets
concepts.description: The estimate of the value of the leased asset at the end of the lease term.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure, Recurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregation of the liabilities reported on the balance sheet measured at fair value on a recurring basis by the entity.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-term Line of Credit
concepts.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

concepts.label: Line of Credit Facility, Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount borrowed under the credit facility as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Repayments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Decrease for amounts repaid on the credit facility for the period.

concepts.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
concepts.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

concepts.label: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
concepts.description: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

concepts.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
concepts.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (that is, noncontrolling interest, previously referred to as minority interest).

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
concepts.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Operating Partnerships
concepts.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners in an operating partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
concepts.description: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Parent
concepts.description: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, excluding discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases
concepts.description: The net amount due as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

concepts.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
concepts.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
concepts.description: "The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Notes Payable
concepts.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Notes Payable, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

concepts.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives designated as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.

concepts.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
concepts.description: Future minimum rental payments in aggregate as of the balance sheet date under operating leases.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Current
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within one year of the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Five Years
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fifth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Four Years
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fourth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Three Years
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within the third year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Thereafter
concepts.description: Future minimum lease payments receivable under operating leases for periods greater than five years following the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Gross appreciation or the gross loss in value of the total unsold securities. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) in accumulated comprehensive income during the period related to pension and other postretirement benefit plans, after tax. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effects of the increase (decrease) to accumulated comprehensive income during the period related to benefit plans. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax effect change in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges after taxes. A cash flow hedge is a hedge of the exposure to variability in the cash flows of a recognized asset or liability or a forecasted transaction that is attributable to a particular risk. The change includes an entity's share of an equity investee's increase or decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Adjustment that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency of the reporting entity, net of tax.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents Other Comprehensive Income or Loss, Net of Tax, for the period. Includes deferred gains or losses on qualifying hedges, unrealized holding gains or losses on available-for-sale securities, minimum pension liability, and cumulative translation adjustment. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax effect of the reclassification adjustment for accumulated gains and losses from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges included in accumulated comprehensive income that was realized in net income during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
concepts.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Investment Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
concepts.description: Value of the other investment not readily marketable determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques, that was used to record the investment for financial reporting purposes.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Noncontrolling Interests
concepts.description: Carrying amount of equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in one or more of the entities consolidated into the reporting entity's financial statements other than joint ventures, limited partnerships, operating partnerships or interests held by preferred unit holders.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Expense
concepts.description: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
concepts.description: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

concepts.label: Other Short-term Borrowings
concepts.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are due within one year or operating cycle, if longer, from the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Payments for Legal Settlements
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

concepts.label: Payments for Merger Related Costs
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

concepts.label: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
concepts.description: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
concepts.description: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
concepts.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

concepts.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

concepts.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
concepts.description: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

concepts.label: Payments of Dividends
concepts.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payments of Financing Costs
concepts.description: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
concepts.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

concepts.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The carrying amount, as of the date of the latest financial statement presented, of finance receivables which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, primarily a secured borrowing or repurchase agreement, and for which the transferee is not permitted to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.description: Total number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued to shareholders (includes related preferred shares that were issued, repurchased, and remain in the treasury). May be all or portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. Excludes preferred shares that are classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Prepaid Taxes
concepts.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Benefit, Reduction in Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation for Subsidy (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the reduction in the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for the government subsidy related to prescription drug benefits attributed to past service. Disclosure relates to the first period in which an employer includes the effects of the subsidy in measuring the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation and net periodic postretirement benefit cost.

concepts.label: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Managed and Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
concepts.description: This is the sum of principal amount outstanding for both securitized and unsecuritized loans of all types.

concepts.label: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
concepts.description: This is the principal amount outstanding for securitized loans only (across all types of loans).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
concepts.description: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
concepts.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of other physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
concepts.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
concepts.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

concepts.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Discount
concepts.description: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the discount on the note or receivable which is deducted from the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is the difference between the present value and the face amount.

concepts.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount
concepts.description: The receivable or note face amount less the unamortized discount or premium.

concepts.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of the recorded obligation to transfer funds in the future for fixed or minimum amounts or quantities of goods or services at fixed or minimum prices (for example, as in take-or-pay contracts or throughput contracts).

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Repayments of Debt
concepts.description: The cash outflow during the period from the repayment of aggregate short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

concepts.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
concepts.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

concepts.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
