concepts.label: Restricted Cash, Current
concepts.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.description: The cumulative amount of the reporting entity's undistributed earnings or deficit.

concepts.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
concepts.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

concepts.label: Revenues
concepts.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
concepts.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
concepts.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.

concepts.label: Sales Revenue, Goods, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate revenue during the period from the sale of goods in the normal course of business, after deducting returns, allowances and discounts.

concepts.label: Sales Revenue, Services, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Aggregate revenue during the period from services rendered in the normal course of business, after deducting allowances and discounts.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Asset Reconciling Item, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of an item in the reconciliation of total assets from reportable segments to the entity's consolidated assets.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Depreciation Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of depreciation expense for the reportable segment. Such disclosure is presented if the amount is: (a) included in the measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in that measure of segment profit or loss.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Total expenditures for additions to long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets of the reportable segment.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Net Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of net assets (total assets less total liabilities) attributed to the reportable segment.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Tangible assets attributed to the reportable segment for use in the production or supply of goods and services, for rental to others, or for administrative purposes, net of accumulated depreciation. Examples include land, buildings, machinery, vehicles, furniture, and computer equipment.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting Information, Revenue for Reportable Segment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of total revenue for the reportable segments, including revenue from external customers, transactions with other operating segments of the same entity, and (gross) interest revenue. All considered to be "operating revenue" for purposes of the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Items, Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Total of reconciling items between total reportable segments' revenues and consolidated entity revenues.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Segment Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Total assets for reportable segments.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Segment Operating Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: The total amount of profit or loss for reportable segments.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Segment Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
concepts.description: Total revenues for reportable segments.

concepts.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

concepts.label: Severance Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: The charge against earnings in the period for known and estimated costs of termination benefits provided to current employees that are involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination or a discontinued operation as defined by generally accepted accounting principles and costs associated with one-time termination benefits.

concepts.label: Severance Costs
concepts.description: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
concepts.description: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The maximum period of time an equity-based award is expected to be outstanding. An equity-based award's expected term is generally determined based on, among other factors, the instrument's contractual term and the effects of employees' expected exercise and post-vesting employment termination behavior.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The minimum period of time an equity-based award is expected to be outstanding. An equity-based award's expected term is generally determined based on, among other factors, the instrument's contractual term and the effects of employees' expected exercise and post-vesting employment termination behavior.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
concepts.description: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Maximum
concepts.description: The estimated measure of the maximum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Minimum
concepts.description: The estimated measure of the minimum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
concepts.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Maximum
concepts.description: The maximum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
concepts.description: The minimum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
concepts.description: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
concepts.description: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.description: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: The weighted average period between the balance sheet date and expiration for all vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable (or convertible) under the plan, which may be expressed in a decimal value for number of years.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
concepts.description: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
concepts.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
concepts.description: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Short-term Debt
concepts.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
concepts.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Short-term Investments
concepts.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

concepts.label: Short-term Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of stockholders' equity including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interests, after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
concepts.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
concepts.description: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
concepts.description: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
concepts.description: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
concepts.description: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
concepts.description: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
concepts.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
concepts.description: The number of shares authorized to be repurchased by an entity's Board of Directors under a stock repurchase plan.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
concepts.description: The remaining number of shares authorized to be repurchased by an entity's Board of Directors under a stock repurchase plan.

concepts.label: Sublease Income
concepts.description: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

concepts.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Severance Benefits
concepts.description: Liability for amount due employees, in addition to wages and any other money that employers owe employees, when their employment ends through a layoff or other termination. For example, a company may provide involuntarily terminated employees with a lump sum payment equal to one week's salary for every year of employment.

concepts.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Amount
concepts.description: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

concepts.label: Taxes Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
concepts.description: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Shares
concepts.description: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
concepts.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Value
concepts.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
concepts.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

concepts.label: Unamortized Debt Issuance Expense
concepts.description: The remaining balance of debt issuance expenses that were capitalized and are being amortized against income over the lives of the respective bond issues. This does not include the amounts capitalized as part of the cost of the utility plant or asset.

concepts.label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
concepts.description: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
concepts.description: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
concepts.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
concepts.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
concepts.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
concepts.description: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

concepts.label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
concepts.description: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
concepts.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
concepts.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
concepts.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge
concepts.description: Amount of liability hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

concepts.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

concepts.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from adjustments after acquisition date under purchase accounting of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
concepts.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
concepts.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Gain (Loss), Immediate Recognition as Component in Net Periodic Benefit (Cost) Credit
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss), recognized immediately as component of net periodic benefit (cost) credit, for change in value of benefit obligation or plan assets from experience different from that assumed, change in actuarial assumption, or consequence of temporarily deviating from substantive plan. Includes, but is not limited to, amount in excess of ten percent of greater of fair value of plan assets or benefit obligation.

concepts.label: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
concepts.description: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
concepts.description: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
concepts.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

concepts.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationCurrent
Common Stock, Value, Outstanding
concepts.description: Value of all classes of common stock held by shareholders. May be all or portion of the number of common shares authorized. These shares exclude common shares repurchased by the entity and held as treasury shares.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Business Exit Costs
concepts.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to impairment loss.

concepts.label: Legal Fees
concepts.description: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

concepts.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
concepts.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
concepts.description: Percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the debt instrument.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

concepts.label: InterestExpenseNonoperating
Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectAmount
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectPercent
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense.

concepts.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

SupplierFinanceProgramObligationIncrease
Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

concepts.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
concepts.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated
concepts.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a result of restructuring activities.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Current
concepts.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount
concepts.description: Amount remaining of a stock repurchase plan authorized.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock Acquired, Average Cost Per Share
concepts.description: Total cost of shares repurchased divided by the total number of shares repurchased.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Plan Amendments, Tax Effect
concepts.description: Tax effect of plan amendments that occurred that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost.
